conservation.condition_narrative: There are numerous generalized holidays in the artist's technique at the margins between forms, where brushstrokes do not meet, and the primed canvas is visible. There is a very slight, barely visible stretcher bar crease in the center left vertical with no cracks. There are stable, vertical, hairline cracks at the tacking edge on the left and right margins of the work, as indicated. There are two pinpoint, dry accretions visible in the lower left and right corners, as well as one accretion in the upper right corner. There is a loose fiber on the interior of the glazing in the lower left corner that casts a shadow in direct lighting. There are artist's media transfers across the lower edge. There are finger smudges on the tacking edges and the top of the mountain form.
conservation.technical_description:
**Support:** The support is a commercially primed linen with additional lead/zinc priming by the artist. 
 
 
 
**Ground or Support Preparation:** The processed linen canvas has an artist-applied primer, apparently consisting of roughly equal parts 2PbCO3•Pb(OH)2 and ZnO in oil. 
 
 
 
**Design Layers:** Thinly applied matte and gloss creams with ridges of paint often at the edges of forms. Holidays in the artist's application of paint occur frequently at the margins of forms. Work also has isolated areas of subtractive work by the artist. 
 
 
 
**Surface Coating:** The painting appears to be unvarnished. 
 
 
 
**Framing, Backing, and Hanging Hardware:** The painting is installed in a reproduction, Georgia O'Keeffe/George Of-designed micro-environmentally controlled "clam shell" profile frame.
